map.title: Concept map of a Playwright test run

runner.text: The main Node process. It reads the config, finds tests, starts workers and collects results.

config.text: playwright.config: projects, workers, use options, webServer, global setup.

group.text: Tests that need the same project and worker fixtures and come from one file. A worker takes a whole group.

worker.text: A separate Node process. It runs the tests of its groups one at a time and keeps worker fixtures between them.

fixture.text: A value a test asks for by name. Playwright builds it before the test and cleans it up after.

builtin.text: Ships with Playwright: playwright, browser, context, page, request and options such as browserName.

custom.text: Added with test.extend. It can depend on built-in fixtures and on each other.

scope.text: A worker fixture is built once per worker and reused. A test fixture is built for every test.

browser.text: A browser process that Playwright launches. Chromium by default (browserName).

context.text: An isolated browser session with its own cookies and storage.

client.text: Your calls go to a client object. It sends each call as a message to the server, which drives the browser. In a test run both live in the worker.

request.text: An API context that sends HTTP from Node. It needs no browser.

ownCookies.text: The request fixture has its own cookie jar. storageState copies cookies once; later changes are not shared.

sharedCookies.text: page.request uses the page’s browser-context cookie jar. Response cookies go back into that same jar.

map.title: Logical browser, context, page and frame relationships

browser.text: A browser holds contexts. These are logical object relationships, not a process per object.

context.text: A context holds pages and keeps its own cookies and local storage.

page.text: Each page has one main frame; iframes add child frames.

frame.text: A main frame contains child frames, which can contain nested frames.

isolation.text: Both pages open the same example site. Their contexts do not share cookies or local storage.

state.text: Context A · ID A; cookies + storage · A; available ✓. Context B · ID B; cookies + storage · B; available ✓.

closedA.text: Context A: closed; its Page A and frame tree: closed. Context B and Page B: available ✓.

closedBoth.text: Context A and Context B: closed; both pages and their frame trees: closed.

shortcut.text: browser.newPage() creates a page and its own context. Closing that page also closes its owned context.

ordinary.text: Without an owned context, page.close() closes the page channel by default.

closedOwned.text: The shortcut page and its page-owned context are closed.

target.text: No server object answers the call. The error does not identify which close ran first.

redirect.text: Recorded redirects are followed; 301/302 changes POST to GET, and 303 changes non-GET/HEAD methods.

missing.text: No matching recorded request returns noentry.

abort.text: A missing request aborts unless notFound is fallback.

fallback.text: A missing request passes onward with notFound: fallback.

defaults.text: Recording defaults to minimal mode and attached content.

export.text: context.close() exports the recording; keep attached files or ZIP entries.

guard.text: A fixture whose selected slot is already exhausted does not start its teardown.
